verdict.rationale: Circle's own documentation shows the building blocks of fiat settlement. Qualified businesses can use a Circle Mint account to convert USDC to and from USD at no additional cost, and USDC/EURC are redeemable 1:1 for fiat. CPN also lets partners deliver local fiat, with a managed mode in which Circle handles settlement. However, nothing documents an automatic sweep that converts incoming stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout, so a merchant's books would still briefly hold USDC. Missing for 10: a documented auto-conversion or auto-settlement setting for incoming stablecoin payments, an explicit flow paying merchant receipts out to the merchant's own bank account, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a fiat-settlement workflow.
